origin.description: Store each value in a file so it outlives this process.

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: Directory for the files. It is created when missing.

arguments.name: algo
arguments.text: Hash used as the file name when memoise uses this cache.

origin.details: The file holds a pickle of the value. The check compares the value read back.
origin.value: A cache with set, get, has_key, drop_key, reset, keys, and digest.
origin.example:
td <- tempfile("mc")
fs <- cache_filesystem(td)
fs$set("abc", 4)
cat(paste(fs$get("abc")), "\n", sep = "")
